_que_es: Fotos de zona (índice y ventana Worlds), un bioma por cuadro, 2026-11-02. python tools/imagegen.py generate skills/_shared/iconos/recetas/zonas.json --ref <fondo de carga> --quality high --n 1 --out <carpeta>; python tools/storeart.py finish skills/_shared/iconos/recetas/zonas.json --sheet <hoja>.png --out assets/ui/zone-art.

ia.prompt: Nine biomes, in this order: 1) meadow: a sunny meadow with green hills, flowers, blocky trees and a small windmill, 2) beach: a tropical beach with golden sand, palm trees, turquoise water and a beach hut, 3) candy: a candy land with pink hills, giant lollipops, gumdrops and a chocolate river, 4) snow: snowy peaks with pine trees, ice crystals and a cozy wooden cabin, 5) jungle: a lush jungle with giant leaves, vines, a waterfall and ancient stone ruins, 6) desert: a desert with orange dunes, cactuses, a small oasis and a pyramid, 7) volcano: a volcano island with glowing lava rivers, dark rocks and fire crystals, 8) space: a purple alien planet with craters, glowing crystals, rings and stars in the sky, 9) underwater: an underwater coral reef with colorful corals, bubbles and a sunken treasure chest.
